people.mina: Mina Harker with the cross-within-a-circle scar in the centre of her forehead, as in the reference

beats.text: Render the mark in the centre of her forehead clearly and vividly, exactly like the reference portrait: a crisp dark-red scar of an equal-armed cross inside a clean thin circle, sharply drawn, glowing faintly as it burns, with the wisp of white smoke rising straight up from it. Keep the smoke where it is. Keep her face, expression, eyes, hair, scarf, light and background exactly as they are.
